summary: Frontend-only mobile app 'Resonance' (Expo/React Native web preview) tested end-to-end via Playwright at 390x844. All 15 requested feature areas are functional: Home carousels + quick chips + home-favorites, bottom tab navigation, Library segments + sort chips + song row playback + mini-player, song options bottom sheet with all 7 options, TrackCard tap opens /player, Now Playing full controls (toggle/next/prev/seek/shuffle/repeat/favorite/close/add-playlist/queue/sleep), sleep-15 sheet, Queue screen (jump/remove/clear/save), Playlists tab with new-playlist-btn, /playlist/edit/new (pl-name, pl-cover-pick, 6 pl-color options, pl-save) - creating playlist adds it to grid and detail shows collection-play/collection-shuffle/collection-back/playlist-edit, Search live filter + recent history + clear, Settings (theme light/dark/system, shuffle, repeat, scan-music does not crash on web, restore-demo, clear-history, clear-search, reset-library confirm-dialog with confirm-ok/confirm-cancel), Album/Artist/Genre/Year detail screens all render CollectionView with collection-play/shuffle/back, Edit metadata /edit/[id] with all fields + save. No deprecated packages detected (expo-av/barcode-scanner/background-fetch absent). No React Native red screen. Audio playback state toggling verified (mini-player advances title on next).
action_items: MINOR (nit): Library album grid uses testID pattern 'album-<Album Name>' instead of a card-prefixed pattern like 'album-card-<name>'. Playlists use 'playlist-card-<id>' which is more consistent. Not blocking. Consider unifying if standardization desired.

MINOR (nit): Console shows deprecated React-Native-Web style warnings ('shadow* props deprecated -> use boxShadow', 'props.pointerEvents deprecated -> use style.pointerEvents'). Non-blocking web-only warnings coming from RN internals/third-party libs, but you can silence them by migrating any shadow* / pointerEvents style usage in your components to the new syntax.
critical_code_review_comments: All files are under 700 lines and well-organized (repo.ts is largest at ~410 lines).
Env var EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL correctly set; there is no backend usage which matches the offline-only architecture.
testID coverage is excellent - every interactive element in the review request has a corresponding testID.
No mongodb _id issues (frontend only, no backend).
MiniPlayer floats above 60px tab bar as expected; safe area insets handled via useSafeAreaInsets.
seed_data_creation: None manually created. App auto-seeded 12 demo tracks across 4 albums + 'Late Night Drive' playlist as expected. Also created a 'TEST Playlist X' during playlist-create flow verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend-only Expo app. Use EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL as base preview URL. All routes are Expo Router paths: /, /library, /playlists, /search, /settings, /player, /queue, /playlist/[id], /playlist/edit/new, /album/[name], /artist/[name], /genre/[name], /year/[year], /folder/[name], /edit/[id]. Data persists via JSON store (loadDB/schedulePersist). Album/Artist/Genre/Folder ids are URL-encoded names, not uuids. Library album cards use testID='album-<AlbumName>' (not 'album-card-<id>').
